from pathlib import Path
import os, shutil, subprocess, json
base=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
root=base/'data/attribution-mutations';root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
controls=['test_processing_outcomes_and_omission_do_not_become_no_candidate[failed]', 'test_cli_denies_export_before_reading_recordings[resolve-holders]']
cases=[
('unresolved-competitor','if any(m.referent is None for m in candidates)','if False and any(m.referent is None for m in candidates)','test_resolved_third_person_holder_carries_antecedent_but_open_competitor_blocks'),
('identity-collapse','if len(referents) != 1','if len(candidates) != 1','test_complete_small_candidate_space_matches_declared_partition_including_open_candidates'),
('document-ownership','entity is None or entity.origin_document != document.id','entity is None','test_same_side_other_document_candidate_is_not_a_holder'),
('evidence-containment','if not contained_in(support, context.evidence):','if False and not contained_in(support, context.evidence):','test_context_support_union_preserves_discontinuous_gaps'),
('recompute','if checked != expected:','if False and checked != expected:','test_changed_input_identity_and_forged_results_are_rejected_at_consumption'),
]
records=[]
for name,old,new,test in cases:
 case=root/name;case.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 shutil.copytree(base/'src/storymodel',case/'storymodel',dirs_exist_ok=True)
 for fn in ['test_attribution.py','test_identity.py']:
  shutil.copy2(base/'tests'/fn,case/fn)
 env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=str(case),PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
 cmd=[str(base/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','pytest','-q',*[f'test_attribution.py::{t}' for t in [test,*controls]]]
 record={'mutation':name,'old':old,'new':new,'test':test,'controls':controls}
 for mode in ['baseline','mutant']:
  if mode=='mutant':
   path=case/'storymodel/attribution.py';content=path.read_text();assert content.count(old)==1
   path.write_text(content.replace(old,new))
   subprocess.run([str(base/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','py_compile',str(path)],check=True)
   shutil.rmtree(case/'storymodel/__pycache__',ignore_errors=True)
  result=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=case,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
  (case/f'{mode}.log').write_text(result.stdout+result.stderr)
  expected='3 passed' if mode=='baseline' else '1 failed, 2 passed'
  assert result.returncode==(0 if mode=='baseline' else 1) and expected in result.stdout,(name,mode,result.stdout,result.stderr)
  record[mode]=result.stdout.splitlines()[-1]
 record['compiled']=True;records.append(record);print(name,record['mutant'])
(root/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')

installed.reproduction_python:
from pathlib import Path
import json, os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
base=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
python=base/'data/wheel-env/bin/python'
cli=base/'data/wheel-env/bin/storymodel'
env=dict(os.environ);env.pop('PYTHONPATH',None)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='storymodel-attribution-') as temp:
 root=Path(temp)
 shutil.copy2(base/'examples/attribution_workflow.py',root/'example.py')
 subprocess.run([str(python),'example.py','example'],cwd=root,env=env,check=True)
 directory=root/'example'
 inputs=['account.json','identity-annotations.json','holder-proposals.json']
 subprocess.run([str(cli),'resolve-holders',*inputs,'--output','cli.json'],cwd=directory,env=env,check=True)
 verification=subprocess.run([str(cli),'verify-attribution',*inputs,'cli.json'],cwd=directory,env=env,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
 subprocess.run([str(cli),'attribution-table',*inputs,'cli.json','--output','cli-table.json'],cwd=directory,env=env,check=True)
 assert json.loads((directory/'cli.json').read_text())==json.loads((directory/'attribution.json').read_text())
 assert json.loads((directory/'cli-table.json').read_text())==json.loads((directory/'situations.json').read_text())
 probe='''import json
from pathlib import Path
import storymodel
from storymodel import read_supported_account, resolve_context_holders, verify_attribution, attribution_table
from storymodel.attribution import AttributionResult
from storymodel.serialization import canonical,digest
assert "site-packages" in storymodel.__file__,storymodel.__file__
account=read_supported_account(Path("account.json"))
before=account.model_dump_json()
forms=Path("identity-annotations.json").read_text();proposals=Path("holder-proposals.json").read_text()
result=resolve_context_holders(account,forms,proposals)
assert result==AttributionResult.model_validate_json(Path("cli.json").read_bytes())
verify_attribution(account,forms,proposals,result)
rows=attribution_table(account,forms,proposals,result)
assert rows[-1].holder.status=="named"
assert len(rows[-1].holder.candidates)==2
assert rows[-1].context.kind=="reported"
assert account.model_dump_json()==before
# Private API output remains denied; verification must not grant export.
denied=account.model_copy(update={"export_permission":"denied"})
sha=digest(denied.model_dump(mode="json"))
f=json.loads(forms);p=json.loads(proposals);f['account_sha256']=p['account_sha256']=sha
f=canonical(f);p=canonical(p)
r=resolve_context_holders(denied,f,p)
assert r.export_permission=="denied"
for name,data in [('denied-account',denied.model_dump_json()),('denied-forms',f),('denied-proposals',p),('denied-result',r.model_dump_json())]:
 Path(name+'.json').write_text(data)
print(json.dumps({'import':storymodel.__file__,'situations':len(rows),'holder_candidates':len(rows[-1].holder.candidates),'unchanged_account':True}))
'''
 api=subprocess.run([str(python),'-c',probe],cwd=directory,env=env,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
 private=subprocess.run([str(cli),'verify-attribution','denied-account.json','denied-forms.json','denied-proposals.json','denied-result.json'],cwd=directory,env=env,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
 for command in ['resolve-holders','attribution-table']:
  args=[str(cli),command,'denied-account.json','missing-forms','missing-proposals']
  if command=='attribution-table':args.append('missing-result')
  denied=subprocess.run([*args,'--output','must-not-exist.json'],cwd=directory,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
  assert denied.returncode==2 and 'producer denies attribution export' in denied.stderr
  assert not (directory/'must-not-exist.json').exists()
 output={'api':json.loads(api.stdout),'cli_verification':json.loads(verification.stdout),'denied_verification':json.loads(private.stdout),'cli_api_equal':True,'denied_producers_refused_before_inputs':True,'artifact_bytes':{p.name:p.stat().st_size for p in directory.glob('*.json')}}
 (base/'data/attribution-installed.json').write_text(json.dumps(output,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(json.dumps(output,indent=2))
